featured_reviews.name: Shubhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our one-night stay at Sea Hill and Forest View Villa was truly memorable and very comfortable. The peaceful surroundings and the beautiful view of both the sea and the forest created such a calm and refreshing atmosphere, making it the perfect escape from the city.

The villa is spacious, beautifully designed, and spread across several levels. The interiors are elegant, with warm lighting and a modern yet homely touch. Everything was clean and well-maintained, from the bedrooms to the bathrooms. The private pool was spotless and inviting, and the rooftop jacuzzi added a lovely touch of luxury, especially in the evening when the lights around the villa made the place feel cozy and peaceful.

Since the villa is located slightly in the interior, it’s best to plan meals ahead of time. They offer freshly prepared home-cooked food at an additional cost of ₹850 per person for vegetarian meals and ₹950 for non-vegetarian. The food was delicious, homely, and made with care, and although outside food isn’t allowed, we didn’t mind because the meals were worth it.

The caretaker was polite and helpful, though sometimes a bit slow to respond. There’s also a friendly dog on the property, which added to the homely feel, but it would be nice if the host ensured he was looked after regularly. The road leading to the villa is a bit uneven and can be confusing at first, so using GPS and confirming directions beforehand really helps.

A few small improvements could make the stay even better, like adding basic toiletries in each bathroom and making the access to the rooftop jacuzzi safer, as the steel ladder can be slippery when wet. During our visit, the kitchen was clean and had everything needed, although most guests would likely prefer the home-cooked meals provided by the host.

Overall, Sea Hill and Forest View Villa is a wonderful place for families or groups of friends looking for a private and peaceful retreat surrounded by nature. The mix of cleanliness, comfort, and scenic beauty makes it a perfect spot to unwind. Despite a few minor issues, our overall experience was excellent. It’s a place that combines tranquility and comfort beautifully, and we would definitely love to return in the future.

A Perfect Getaway with Friends!

I recently visited this
resort in Uttan with my group of friends, and it was one of the most fun and refreshing trips we’ve had in a while! The place was peaceful and beautifully maintained, with a relaxing vibe that made us forget the city chaos instantly.

From the moment we arrived, the staff was welcoming and helpful. The rooms were clean, spacious, and had a cozy feel. We spent hours by the pool, played music, laughed, and clicked tons of pictures. featured_reviews.name: Kinjal Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had booked Astrid villa in Parmar Farm House. Absolutely horrible experience. The property advertised 3 rooms, but one of them was just a makeshift room on the parapet/terrace without a proper bathroom. None of the basic facilities worked properly — flushes were not working, there was no water in the sink, and the ACs were non-functional.

The hospitality was even worse. Breakfast sent for 5 people looked like it was meant for just 1 person. They literally sent one small butter packet of 5 gms for 5 guests, and the overall food packing and quantity were pathetic. Tea and coffee for 5 people came in plastic bags barely enough for 2.

The food orders even after pre ordering and giving time in advance came almost two hours later.

Sarah from the management is absolutely rude and non competent. Narmisha from housekeeping started walking out when we were taking to him.

Completely mismanaged and not worth the money. Avoid this property at all costs.
